parameters.name: DeleteOnRelease
parameters.description: Specifies whether to retain the ENI when the associated instance is released. Valid values:

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description:
The description of the ENI. The description must be 2 to 255 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://.

Default value: empty.

parameters.name: EnhancedNetwork
parameters.description: This parameter is not publicly available.

parameters.name: NetworkInterfaceName
parameters.description: The name of the ENI. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. The name can contain characters under the letter categorization in Unicode, including English letters, Chinese characters, and digits. It can also contain colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), or hyphens (-).

parameters.name: NetworkInterfaceTrafficConfig
parameters.description: The communication parameters of the network interface controller (NIC).

parameters.name: QueueNumber
parameters.description: The number of queues for the ENI. Valid values: 1 to 2048.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the ENI. You can invoke [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: RxQueueSize
parameters.description: The inbound queue depth of the network interface controller (NIC).

parameters.name: SecurityGroupId
parameters.description:
The IDs of security groups. The secondary ENI is added to the specified security groups and removed from the existing security groups.

- The valid values of N depend on the quota for the maximum number of security groups to which an ENI can belong. For more information, see [Before you begin](~~25412#SecurityGroupQuota~~).

- The modification takes effect shortly, but a slight delay may occur.

parameters.name: SourceDestCheck
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable source/destination checking. We recommend that you enable this feature to improve network security. Valid values:

parameters.name: TxQueueSize
parameters.description: The outbound queue depth of the network interface controller (NIC).
